title: Wistia email 2 video thumbnail click win

change.control: Email 2 about camera sliders uses a plain static image.
change.variant: Overlay a video play button and timestamp on the same image in email 2, keeping copy and subject identical.

conversions.unit: recipients clicking any link in the email

significance.reported: Publisher explicitly calls this result statistically significant.

quote: This came out to 24.38% higher engagement with the video thumbnail email than the image email.
notes: Distinct randomized email send in a seven-test series; recipient lists sometimes overlap. Outcome includes clicks on all email links, not just thumbnail clicks. Preserve reported lift rather than recomputing rounded rates or reconciling click-count discrepancies. 50/50 list split reported but arm sample counts not separately published.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
